diagnostic_gate.condition_a: PASS if mean head-cosine target-level Spearman >= mean full-cosine Spearman - 0.02 and head is not worse than full in at least 5 of 9 quantiles
diagnostic_gate.condition_b: PASS if q0.1-vs-q0.9 head-relation Spearman is at least 0.15 below mean adjacent-quantile relation Spearman, or is below 0.60
diagnostic_gate.condition_c: PASS if target-block bootstrap 95% CI lower bound for head Top-10 empirical utility minus random Top-10 utility is >0
diagnostic_gate.condition_d: PASS if mean adjacent head-relation Top-10 Jaccard minus q0.1-vs-q0.9 Jaccard is >=0.15
diagnostic_gate.condition_e: PASS if at least 5 of 15 legacy targets have higher round-mean Top-10 empirical utility under head cosine than full cosine and the legacy macro mean difference is >0
diagnostic_gate.gate_rule: At least 3 of 5 conditions must pass before any QA-head aggregation implementation
